_note: Draft onboarding spoken by the uniformed Port Officer at passport control after body selection.

a.speaker: port_officer
a.text: There you are! Download complete. All your bits arrived, and only one of them was late.

d.speaker: port_officer
d.text: Look around. Then zoom in on the cube to read your assignment.

waiting.speaker: port_officer
waiting.text: Zoom in on the lit cube on the counter.

again.speaker: port_officer
again.text: Your entry document is at Lost & found.
